rationale: The prior actor-binding inconsistency has been resolved: compiled.bindings.actor now correctly matches case.acting_user_id (U01AGENBOT9). The access_plan and actor (U01AGENBOT9, a T01WORKSPACE member already present in general/random/engineering and with visibility into remaining public channels via unrestricted team-wide endpoints like conversations.list/users.list/conversations.members) support real, documented API discovery consistent with the domain model.
